{{1952 Midwest Conference football standings}}
The '''1952 Coe Kohawks football team''' represented [[Coe College]] as a member of the [[Midwest Conference]] (MWC) during the [[1952 college football season]]. Led by fifth-year head coach [[Dick Clausen]], the Kohawks compiled an overall record of 7–1 with a mark of 6–0 in conference play, winning the MWC title.<ref>{{cite web |author=<!--Staff writer(s); no by-line.--> |title=Conference Football Standings 1952 |url=https://static.midwestconference.org/custompages/Past%20MWC%20Seasons/Football/1950-53%20fb%20standings.pdf |publisher=[[Midwest Conference]] |access-date=February 21, 2024 }}</ref> Coe played home games at the newly opened [[Kingston Stadium]] in [[Cedar Rapids, Iowa]].
